description: A Dart class defining an authentication service for a Flutter application, providing methods for login, signup, and logout with state management via ChangeNotifier.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class managing authentication state, including login, signup, and logout functionalities.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, updates internal state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, updates internal state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clearing internal state and notifying listeners.
